mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 63 degrees and overcast skies at Verona City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city has announced that a segment of Highway M will be closed for road work from October 6 through October 9, and residents can also participate in early, in-person absentee voting at City Hall for the November 3 election.

We have a full slate of activities today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly look back at local incidents, on September 21, police identified and cited a person who stole Swedish Fish candy from a local store.
Today's flavor of the day is Double Strawberry, and you can stop by when the doors open today at 10:00 AM.
